scope: Actual frontend TypeScript HTTP adapters and session code executed against the live API with in-memory web-storage adapters. No browser layout/device assertion.

checks.name: Frontend readiness adapter reads real SQLite state
Frontend auth adapter signs in and scopes persisted session
Frontend subject adapter resolves wildcard to registered profiles
Frontend Health and Monitor read actual no-data responses
Frontend Library search and detail preserve original content
Frontend AI adapter reads availability without inventing output
Frontend Care adapters persist and reload an explicit test record
Changing server origin blocks stale bearer before transmission
Frontend sign out clears storage and revokes the captured bearer
